indications: alcohol withdrawal (chlordiazepoxide preferred but diazepam also used)

dosing.anxiety: 2 mg three times daily (5 mg tds in severe cases); elderly 2 mg twice daily
dosing.alcohol_withdrawal: 10-20 mg initially, then 10 mg 4-6 hourly prn, taper over 5-7 days

withdrawal: reduce by ~10% every 1-2 weeks initially, slower (5% or less) as dose gets low; total taper months in long-term users; switch to diazepam from shorter-acting benzos first
